verses.1: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. How lovely are your dwellings, LORD of Armies!
verses.2: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of the LORD. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
verses.3: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, LORD of Armies, my King, and my God.
verses.4: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.
verses.5: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.
verses.6: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.
verses.7: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.
verses.8: LORD, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.
verses.9: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.
verses.10: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.11: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
verses.12: LORD of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
